_description: Configures which technical indicators to compute on which assets and from which data source. Each stream entry defines one asset/timeframe/source combination and the list of indicators to compute on it. source='binance_ws' fetches live klines from Binance WebSocket and seeds from REST on startup. source='feed' accumulates best_bid ticks from the ZeroMQ Polymarket feed.

streams._comment: RSI 14 and rolling volatility on 4h BTC/USDT candles from Binance
